versions.changelog:
Initial release: advanced SERP-overlap topic clustering for SEO content architecture.

- Groups keywords into clusters based on SERP overlap, not just text similarity.
- Designs hub-and-spoke content structures with internal linking matrices.
- Expands seed keywords using live Google data and question mining.
- Generates interactive cluster map visualizations.
- Optionally executes content creation if claude-blog is installed.
- Supports importing and enhancing existing SEO strategy files.
